lines.sx1: Simplex mode sends data in one direction only, from the sender to the receiver.
lines.sx2: For example, a computer sending a document to a printer.
lines.hd1: Half duplex sends data in both directions, but not at the same time.
lines.hd2: For example, a walkie talkie: you speak, then you listen.
lines.fd1: Full duplex sends data in both directions at the same time.
lines.fd2: For example, a broadband internet connection.
lines.cm1: So: one direction only, both directions taking turns, or both directions at once.
lines.outro: Simplex, half duplex, full duplex. It is all about direction, and timing.
